verses.original: שִׁ֖יר מִזְמ֣וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ נָכ֣וֹן לִבִּ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָשִׁ֥ירָה וַ֝אֲזַמְּרָ֗ה אַף־ כְּבוֹדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šîr miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ nā·ḵō·wn lib·bî ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ā·šî·rāh wa·’ă·zam·mə·rāh ’ap̄- kə·ḇō·w·ḏî
verses.literal: A song A Psalm of David My heart is steadfast O God I will sing and make music with all my being
verses.literalPt: PREPARADO está o meu coração, ó Deus; cantarei e darei louvores até com a minha glória.

verses.literal: Awake O harp and lyre I will awaken the dawn
verses.literalPt: Despertai, saltério e harpa; eu mesmo despertarei ao romper da alva.

verses.original: אוֹדְךָ֖ בָעַמִּ֥ים׀ יְהוָ֑ה וַ֝אֲזַמֶּרְךָ֗ בַּל־ אֻמִּֽים׃
verses.literal: I will praise You O LORD among the nations I will sing Your praises among the peoples
verses.literalPt: Louvar-te-ei entre os povos, SENHOR, e a ti cantarei louvores entre as nações.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ גָד֣וֹל מֵֽעַל־ שָׁמַ֣יִם חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וְֽעַד־ שְׁחָקִ֥ים אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḡā·ḏō·wl mê·‘al- šā·ma·yim ḥas·de·ḵā wə·‘aḏ- šə·ḥā·qîm ’ă·mit·te·ḵā
verses.literal: For Your loving devotion extends beyond the heavens and Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds
verses.literalPt: Porque a tua benignidade se estende até aos céus, e a tua verdade chega até às mais altas nuvens.

verses.original: ר֣וּמָה עַל־ שָׁמַ֣יִם אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ הָאָ֣רֶץ כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: rū·māh ‘al- šā·ma·yim ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·‘al kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ kə·ḇō·w·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: Be exalted O God above the heavens may Your glory cover all the earth
verses.literalPt: Exalta-te sobre os céus, ó Deus, e a tua glória sobre toda a terra.

verses.original: לְ֭מַעַן יֵחָלְצ֣וּן יְדִידֶ֑יךָ הוֹשִׁ֖יעָה יְמִֽינְךָ֣ וַעֲנֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an yê·ḥā·lə·ṣūn yə·ḏî·ḏe·ḵā hō·wō·šî·‘āh yə·mî·nə·ḵā wa·‘ă·nê·nî
verses.literal: Respond and save us with Your right hand that Your beloved may be delivered
verses.literalPt: Para que sejam livres os teus amados, salva-nos com a tua destra, e ouve-nos.

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀ דִּבֶּ֥ר בְּקָדְשׁ֗וֹ אֶעְלֹ֥זָה אֲחַלְּקָ֥ה שְׁכֶ֑ם וְעֵ֖מֶק סֻכּ֣וֹת אֲמַדֵּֽד׃
verses.literal: God has spoken from His sanctuary I will triumph I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth
verses.literalPt: Deus falou na sua santidade; eu me regozijarei; repartirei a Siquém, e medirei o vale de Sucote.

verses.original: לִ֤י גִלְעָ֨ד׀ לִ֤י מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה וְ֭אֶפְרַיִם מָע֣וֹז רֹאשִׁ֑י יְ֝הוּדָ֗ה מְחֹקְקִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lî ḡil·‘āḏ lî mə·naš·šeh wə·’ep̄·ra·yim mā·‘ō·wz rō·šî yə·hū·ḏāh mə·ḥō·qə·qî
verses.literal: Gilead is Mine and Manasseh is Mine Ephraim is My helmet . . . Judah is My scepter
verses.literalPt: Meu é Gileade, meu é Manassés; e Efraim a força da minha cabeça, Judá o meu legislador.

verses.original: מוֹאָ֤ב׀ סִ֬יר רַחְצִ֗י עַל־ אֱ֭דוֹם אַשְׁלִ֣יךְ נַעֲלִ֑י עֲלֵֽי־ פְ֝לֶ֗שֶׁת אֶתְרוֹעָֽע׃
verses.literal: Moab is My washbasin . . . upon Edom I toss My sandal over Philistia I shout in triumph
verses.literalPt: Moabe a minha bacia de lavar; sobre Edom lançarei o meu sapato, sobre a Filístia jubilarei.

verses.original: מִ֣י יֹ֭בִלֵנִי עִ֣יר מִבְצָ֑ר מִ֖י נָחַ֣נִי עַד־ אֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.literal: Who will bring me to the fortified city Who will lead me to Edom
verses.literalPt: Quem me levará à cidade forte? Quem me guiará até Edom?

verses.original: הֲלֹֽא־ אֱלֹהִ֥ים זְנַחְתָּ֑נוּ וְֽלֹא־ תֵצֵ֥א אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בְּצִבְאֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.literal: Have You not rejected us O God Will You no longer march out O God with our armies
verses.literalPt: Porventura não serás tu, ó Deus, que nos rejeitaste? E não sairás, ó Deus, com os nossos exércitos?

verses.original: הָֽבָה־ לָּ֣נוּ עֶזְרָ֣ת מִצָּ֑ר וְ֝שָׁ֗וְא תְּשׁוּעַ֥ת אָדָֽם׃
verses.literal: Give us aid against the enemy for the help of man is worthless
verses.literalPt: Dá-nos auxílio para sair da angústia, porque vão é o socorro da parte do homem.

verses.original: בֵּֽאלֹהִ֥ים נַעֲשֶׂה־ חָ֑יִל וְ֝ה֗וּא יָב֥וּס צָרֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bê·lō·hîm na·‘ă·śeh- ḥā·yil wə·hū yā·ḇūs ṣā·rê·nū
verses.literal: With God we will perform with valor and He will trample our enemies
verses.literalPt: Em Deus faremos proezas, pois ele calcará aos pés os nossos inimigos.
